person.name: Marina Mogilko
person.positioning: Silicon Valley Girl is a woman-hosted AI, tech and career podcast. Marina Mogilko interviews the founders, researchers and executives building AI, and brings back the part you can use this week.
bio: Marina Mogilko is an entrepreneur, creator and the host of Silicon Valley Girl. Based in Silicon Valley, she interviews founders, researchers and business leaders about AI, the future of work and entrepreneurship, and makes practical videos for people who want to understand and use new technology.
She writes Future Proof, a weekly newsletter on AI tools and career moves, and runs the Silicon Valley Girl channels on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn.

Earlier she co-founded LinguaTrip, an education company, and built linguamarina, one of the largest English-learning channels on YouTube. Those two businesses, an edtech company and a global media company, each passed eight figures in revenue.

facts.text: Host of Silicon Valley Girl, a podcast that was part of the official program of the World Economic Forum in Davos in 2026.
The first creator to receive venture capital funding as an individual, from Slow Ventures in 2021.
Built two eight-figure businesses: LinguaTrip, an education company, and a global media company.
Angel investor in more than 20 startups, including Boom Supersonic, Higgsfield AI, Navier and Beacons.ai.
WIBA Award for Best Influencer in Education, presented at Cannes in 2023.
Cover story of Times Monaco and L'Officiel Cyprus.
